summary: Elevra Lithium Ltd filed a Form 6-K incorporating an ASX announcement of a proposed non-binding term sheet with Morella Corporation to expand their existing joint venture. Four additional exploration projects would be added; Morella can earn a 51% interest by spending A$300,000 within two years, with Elevra retaining 49%. The board approved, with conflicted directors recusing. This is a JV expansion, not a special situation, and the deal is subject to definitive agreements and approvals.
